claim: A frame-locked game can read 0.00% pace whatever the update costs inside; also compare cycles from the wait's end to the update's end, and check frames per update before concluding there is no frame sync.

evidence.text: A game that waits on N interrupts per update makes pace read 0.00% whatever the update costs inside; compare cycles from the wait's end to the update's end too.
The beeper plays only while waiting for the interrupt, so port FE writes fell 8% in busy scenes while update pace matched; the limiter and prepared patterns restored 509.6 / 510.4 a second.
